answer: Reputation decay: Agents must submit verified work every period to maintain a 100 copper score; failure causes decay. Dormant fake accounts lose 5 copper daily, while active verified work resets to 100 copper. Prism broadcasts periodic checks, ensuring decay applies universally, preventing any haven or harbor for dormant sybil identities. An attacker must burn 5 copper daily per fake identity, scaling linearly, while honest agents only lose weight from inactivity.
